en: How can I access my lessons?
Where can I find my lessons?
How do I open a lesson?
or: mu lesson ku kemiti access karibi
hi: main apne lessons ko kaise access karun
mixed: mu lesson ku kaise access karibi
main course lesson kemiti open karun

answers.en: Open your enrolled course or internship from your dashboard and select the lesson you want to access.
answers.or: Dashboard ru tumara enrolled course ba internship open kari jeun lesson access karibaku chahucha taku select kara.
answers.hi: Dashboard se apna enrolled course ya internship open karein aur jis lesson ko access karna hai use select karein.
answers.mixed: Dashboard ru enrolled course ba internship open kari jeun lesson access karibaku chahucha taku select kara.

en: How do I complete a lesson?
How is a lesson marked as completed?
How can I finish a lesson?
My lesson is not marked complete
hi: mera lesson complete nahi ho raha hai
mixed: mu lesson finish karili but complete heuni

answers.en: Complete the required learning activity for the lesson and follow the completion flow provided by the platform. If a lesson remains incomplete after you have completed the required activity, contact support.
answers.or: Lesson pain required learning activity complete kara au platform re deithiba completion flow follow kara. Required activity complete kariba pare madhya lesson incomplete rahile support ku contact kara.
answers.hi: Lesson ke liye required learning activity complete karein aur platform par diya gaya completion flow follow karein. Required activity complete karne ke baad bhi lesson incomplete rahe to support se contact karein.
answers.mixed: Lesson pain required activity complete kari platform ra completion flow follow kara. Tathapi incomplete rahile support ku contact kara.

en: What is included in a lesson?
What learning content is available in lessons?
What can I find inside a lesson?
or: lesson re kana learning content achhi
hi: lesson ke andar kya hota hai
lesson mein kaunsa learning content hai
mixed: lesson bhitare kana learning content achhi
lesson re kya kya content achhi

answers.en: Lesson content depends on the course or internship. Lessons can contain learning notes, key points, examples, code demonstrations, explanations, common mistakes, flashcards and interview questions where provided.
answers.or: Lesson content course ba internship upare depend kare. Lesson re notes, key points, examples, code demonstrations, explanations, common mistakes, flashcards au interview questions thae jouthi provide kara jaithae.
answers.hi: Lesson content course ya internship par depend karta hai. Lessons mein notes, key points, examples, code demonstrations, explanations, common mistakes, flashcards aur interview questions ho sakte hain jahan ye provide kiye gaye hain.
answers.mixed: Lesson content course ba internship upare depend kare. Notes, key points, examples, code demonstrations, explanations, common mistakes au anya learning content milipare.
